facts.business: PBA Infrastructure Limited is primarily engaged in the construction of highways, bridges, runways, heavy RCC structures and other infrastructure projects across India.

auditor.name: N K Mittal & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: 1) Defaults in repayment of obligations to lenders with Rs. 315.15 Crore overdue per SARFAESI notice, consortium dues of Rs. 214.59 Crore, and material uncertainty on going concern; 2) Non-provision of interest since January 2018 as accounts classified as NPA; 3) Revenue recognition on percentage completion method with claims/arbitration money recognized at realizable value but not acknowledged by clients, classified as WIP (Rs. 24.63 Crore total WIP including Rs. 13.07 Crore claims) subject to recoverability uncertainty; 4) Fixed asset register under compilation.

key_risks: Delays in statutory approvals and clearances
Delays in land acquisition and availability of right of way
Non-availability or delayed availability of equipment and skilled manpower
Cost overruns and escalation in input costs
Changes in laws and regulatory requirements
Other unforeseen events, including pandemic and natural disaster risks
Credit risk, market risk, liquidity risk, interest rate risk, foreign exchange risk, operational risk and legal risk
Material uncertainty on going concern due to loan defaults and NPA classification
Uncertainty of recoverability of claims/arbitration money classified as WIP (Rs. 13.07 Crore)
